mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior quarter's growth rate signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > prior quarter growth for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerated GDPC1 growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of elevated UNRATE (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production below the prior quarter's growth rate signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth < prior quarter growth for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).
